Subject: POC: Success criteria & next steps (recap)

Hi Sanjay / Priya,

Thanks again for the call today. Below is a short written recap to make sure we're aligned and can lock the POC runbook.

Summary of goals:
- Primary: reduce avg time-to-resolution for support tickets by surfacing relevant KB articles and suggested responses.
- Secondary: provide short extractive/abstractive summaries for internal triage.

Proposed success criteria (please confirm):
1) KB relevance: >= 75% relevant links on a random sample of 200 tickets (manual review).
2) Triage time savings: >= 20% reduction in average triage time over the evaluation window.
3) Latency: median <= 500ms for single-turn KB surfacing at expected traffic.

Evaluation plan & timeline:
- Week 1 (Jun 21-27): integration and ingest sample dataset (~10k tickets), model config.
- Week 2 (Jun 28-Jul 4): run synthetic and replay traffic, manual reviews.
- Week 3 (Jul 5-11): result analysis and go/no-go.

Owners:
- Redwood: Marissa (program lead), Dev (solutions), Camila (CS ops).
- AcmeCorp: Sanjay (product sponsor), Priya (engineering).

Next steps:
1) Sanjay/Priya: confirm criteria or provide adjustments by EOD Fri Jun 12.
2) Acme: share sanitized ticket export and KB access by Jun 18 (S3 preferred).
3) Redwood: internal readiness and runbook review by Jun 20.

Attachment: POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx (draft metrics).

If that looks good I'll follow up with the kickoff invite for the week of Jun 21.

Thanks,

Hi all,

Thanks Sanjay — makes sense. Proposed rebaseline below; please confirm by EOD Wed Jun 17 so we can finalize the MOP.

Updated scope:
- Core: KB surfacing + suggested responses.
- Added: ticket summarization (one-paragraph manager summary). Summaries will be evaluated separately and will not block KB objective.

Updated success criteria:

2) Time savings: >= 20% for triage.

4) Latency: median <= 600ms to account for summarization step.

Updated timeline:
- Jun 15-26: Redwood internal prep & model config.
- Jul 5-11: data ingest & evaluation run (shifted).
- Jul 12-18: analysis and decision.

Ownership & asks:
- Acme: deliver sanitized export + KB access by Jun 26 and include sample labels where possible.
- Redwood: Dev = integration & perf tuning, Camila = evaluation logistics & manual review coordination, Marissa = program lead.
